notes.title: Untranslated text has been fixed.
notes.content: Fixed untranslated text in the 3F storage.

notes.title: Correction of untranslated parts and English language corrections
notes.content:
Fixed an issue in the Security room on the first floor where some Japanese text would be displayed even if the language setting was set to English, depending on the progress of the game.
Also, some of the English translations have been fixed.

notes.title: Fixed a bug in the Japanese language play
notes.content:
Fixed an issue where an error would occur during some events in the game when playing in Japanese language settings.
To update, uninstall the game using the Steam client and install it last.
The Save file will not be deleted when you do this.
Please note that the Save file may not be protected when uninstalling with other than the Steam client.
